lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Picnic. It is a lovely bright sunny day. Peppa and her family are going for a picnic.
lines.zh: 野餐。今天天气晴朗明媚。佩奇一家要去野餐。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is bringing the picnic basket. Picnic blanket, bread, cheese, tomatoes and lemonade. Is there anything we've forgotten?
lines.zh: 猪爸爸提着野餐篮。野餐垫、面包、奶酪、西红柿和柠檬水。我们有没有忘了什么？

lines.en: Mummy's strawberry? I was just teasing. Mummy's homemade strawberry cake is there, too.
lines.zh: 妈妈的草莓？我刚才是开玩笑的。妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕也在里面。

lines.en: Is everybody ready? Ready! Then let's go.
lines.zh: 大家都准备好了吗？准备好了！那我们出发吧。

lines.en: This looks like just the spot for our picnic.
lines.zh: 这里看起来正是野餐的好地方。

lines.en: Ah, it's great to be outdoors. We should run around a bit and get some exercise.
lines.zh: 啊，在户外真舒服。我们应该跑一跑，锻炼锻炼身体。

lines.en: I want to eat, then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
lines.zh: 我想吃东西，然后睡个午觉。我可不想跑来跑去。

lines.en: Maybe Daddy should run around a bit. His tummy is quite big. My tummy is not big!
lines.zh: 也许爸爸该跑一跑。他的肚子挺大的。我的肚子才不大呢！

lines.en: But later I will get some exercise, even if no one else does.
lines.zh: 不过待会儿我会去锻炼的，就算别人都不去。

lines.en: Let's eat. Good idea, Mummy Pig. I'm really hungry.
lines.zh: 我们开吃吧。好主意，猪妈妈。我真的饿了。

lines.en: Delicious!
lines.zh: 真好吃！

lines.en: I feel quite sleepy. I thought you wanted to run around a bit, Daddy Pig. Later.
lines.zh: 我觉得挺困的。猪爸爸，我以为你想跑一跑呢。待会儿吧。

lines.en: Look, there's a little duck pond.
lines.zh: 看，有一个小鸭子池塘。

lines.en: Mummy, can we feed the ducks? Yes, you can feed them the rest of the bread.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们可以喂鸭子吗？可以，你们可以把剩下的面包喂给它们。

lines.en: Peppa and George love feeding bread to ducks.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢喂鸭子吃面包。

lines.en: Mummy, I think they want some more. That was the last of the bread.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我觉得它们还想吃。面包已经没有了。

lines.en: I'm sure they've had enough. Sorry, Mrs. Duck, we've no more bread.
lines.zh: 我相信它们已经吃饱了。对不起，鸭太太，我们没有面包了。

lines.en: The ducks want more food.
lines.zh: 鸭子还想要更多吃的。

lines.en: So much for Daddy Pig and his exercise.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸的锻炼就到此为止了。

lines.en: You lot again! Peppa told you there's no more bread.
lines.zh: 又是你们！佩奇说了，没有面包了。

lines.en: Mummy, we do have strawberry cake. Well, if there's any cake left over, you can give it to the ducks.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们还有草莓蛋糕呢。好吧，如果蛋糕有剩，你们可以拿去喂鸭子。

lines.en: Everyone likes Mummy Pig's homemade strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢猪妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: Oh, a wasp! I hate wasps. Shoo! What a fuss, Mummy Pig. It's only a little wasp. Go away, wasp!
lines.zh: 哦，一只黄蜂！我讨厌黄蜂。嘘！猪妈妈，真大惊小怪。只是一只小黄蜂。走开，黄蜂！

lines.en: Just stay still, Mummy Pig, then it will fly away.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈，你只要别动，它就会飞走的。

lines.en: There, you see. All you had to do was stay still.
lines.zh: 看吧。你只要不动就行了。

lines.en: Okay, get away! Scram!
lines.zh: 好吧，走开！快滚！

lines.en: Help! Whoa!
lines.zh: 救命！哇哦！

lines.en: Shoo! Get it off me!
lines.zh: 嘘！快把它赶走！

lines.en: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!
lines.zh: 希望黄蜂别蜇到爸爸。哦，走开，你这个小讨厌鬼！

lines.en: No. Daddy Pig is running too fast for the wasp to catch him.
lines.zh: 没有。猪爸爸跑得太快了，黄蜂追不上他。

lines.en: Let's eat our cake before the wasp comes back.
lines.zh: 我们趁黄蜂还没回来，把蛋糕吃了吧。

lines.en: Oh no, we forgot to leave any for the ducks.
lines.zh: 哦不，我们忘了给鸭子留一点。

lines.en: I think I lost it.
lines.zh: 我想我把它弄丢了。

lines.en: You said you would run around and get some exercise, Daddy Pig. But I didn't believe you'd do it.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你说过你会跑一跑锻炼身体。可是我真没想到你做到了。

lines.en: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: Stop, Daddy! We promised the rest of the cake for the ducks.
lines.zh: 停下，爸爸！我们答应过把剩下的蛋糕给鸭子的。

lines.en: Oh. You're very lucky.
lines.zh: 哦。你们可真走运。

lines.en: Say thank you to Daddy Pig. You're most welcome.
lines.zh: 快跟猪爸爸说谢谢。不用客气。

lines.en: It's time to go home. Say goodbye to the ducks. Bye bye, ducks! See you next time.
lines.zh: 该回家了。跟鸭子说再见吧。再见，鸭子们！下次见。
